create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 high-height imprimitive-lift gcd reduction
create.statement_tex: Fix real X>=2, a nonempty literal middle or lower residual hard-M1 shell L>=2, sigma in {+1,-1}, fixed B>0, Q=H_B=floor((log(2X))^B), and a nonempty dyadic Y<h<=2Y with Y>Q. On the exact accepted Round-187 high packet U>4Q, q_U(k)>Q, |k|_U>Q, put m=(k,U), U=mq, k=ma, (a,q)=1. Then c_U(k)=m^(-1)c_q(a), the inverse-residue phase reduces exactly modulo q, and |k|_U=m|a|_q. The complete sector Qm>=Y has total absolute size O_(B,epsilon)(L^2X^epsilon). Its proof uses the inherited live-shell support L<<X^(1/4), O(YL) literal atoms at fixed (kappa,u,U), exact-conductor mass O(m^(-1)log(2q)), and sum_(U|u)tau(U)=tau_3(u), removing Y only through Y/m<=Q before positivity. The exact complementary one-outer-real-part aggregate retains U=mq>4Q, q>Q, m|a|_q>Q, Qm<Y, both orientations, and every literal selector, deletion, endpoint, phase, affine site, and zero extension; its positive capacity remains O_epsilon(YL^2X^epsilon), and its one-sided target is open. The lifted determinant phase is constant along each affine t-ray, while primitive prime near-half modes remain with constant Fourier energy; reciprocity, completion, determinant transposition, sieve opening, and positive energy are mechanism self-return controls, not a disproof. This node proves only the strict imprimitive-lift sector and exact reduction, not the complete high-height relation, complete t=1 residual, small-t owner, any parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent.
create.next_action: Prove the exact one-sided Qm<Y complement uniformly for every dyadic Y>H_B, retaining U=mq>4H_B, q>H_B, m|a|_q>H_B, both orientations, all h,v,t,a, every selector, deletion, endpoint, phase, and zero extension under one outer real part. Gain the complete factor Y through a verified property of the actual endpoint amplitude before positive recombination. Determinant transposition, additive reciprocity alone, assumed height periodicity or bounded variation, positive completion energy, and selector-blind sieve opening are not substitutes.
